'''Mothra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] official serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As a [[Tax Inspector]], he had several run-ins with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]]. On one occasion, while attempting to perform a [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|customs inspection]], Garnet pretended to have contracted a potential fatal infection, the [[Merthian lung infection]]. Mothra, not wishing to contract the malady, retreated from the encounter. Sometime later, Mothra was promoted to the position of [[Associate Governor]]. After running into Garnet once more, he made it clear he knew that the smuggler's former illness had been a hoax, and ordered an [[Mothra's aide|aide]] to keep a close eye on Garnet.
